fields.System.Title: FDN-501 — Create a warehouse
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want to create a warehouse record, so that zones,
locations, and stock have a site to belong to.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a code, name, address, and timezone, when I create a warehouse, then it is
  • created and active.
  • - Given a duplicate warehouse code, then it is rejected.
  • - Given a missing timezone, then it is rejected — timestamps depend on it.
  • - Given a warehouse, then its ID never changes and is never reused.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | warehouse |
| Risks | Missing timezone produces nonsensical event ordering ([doc 09 §9.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
